intro.id: Menentukan kapan dan ke arah mana EA membuka seri baru.
intro.en: Decides when and in which direction the EA opens a new series.

how.id: Tanpa membaca arah: seri BUY dan SELL selalu berjalan bersamaan.
how.en: No direction reading: a BUY and a SELL series always run together.

use.id: Selalu ada sisi yang searah pasar, jadi satu sisi terus menutup basket sementara sisi lain menunggu.
use.en: One side is always with the market, so it keeps closing baskets while the other waits.

how.id: Seri baru hanya searah tren EMA cepat / sedang / besar (bawaan 20 / 50 / 200) di timeframe pilihan, misalnya M15. Syarat 3 EMA sejajar atau cukup 2 EMA.
how.en: New series only in the direction of the fast / mid / slow EMA trend (20 / 50 / 200 by default) on the timeframe you choose, for example M15. Rule: 3 EMAs in line or just 2.

use.id: Mengikuti arus besar pasar, sehingga basket jarang dibuka melawan tren yang kuat.
use.en: Rides the main flow of the market, so baskets are rarely opened against a strong trend.

how.id: Seri baru mengikuti posisi close candle terhadap SMA (bawaan SMA 26 di M1), jenis MA bisa dipilih.
how.en: New series follow where the candle closes against the SMA (SMA 26 on M1 by default); the MA type can be chosen.

use.id: Bereaksi cepat saat arah berbalik, cocok untuk pair yang sering bergelombang.
use.en: Reacts fast when the direction turns, good for pairs that swing a lot.

how.id: EMA tren dan SMA harus searah dulu sebelum seri baru dibuka.
how.en: The EMA trend and the SMA must agree before a new series opens.

use.id: Paling selektif: masuk lebih jarang, tetapi arahnya lebih terkonfirmasi.
use.en: The most selective: fewer entries, a better confirmed direction.

how.id: Satu garis EMA (bawaan EMA 50 di timeframe 3.5, M15) menentukan tren. Tren dianggap berganti bila 2 candle tertutup berturut-turut berada di seberang garis, opsional ditambah jarak aman dan EMA cepat 3.6 di sisi yang sama; status tren disimpan sehingga restart tidak membuatnya bolak-balik. Seri baru hanya dibuka di sisi yang searah tren dan (bawaan) juga menunggu EMA 3.6–3.8 searah menurut aturan 3.9. Sisi lawan DITAHAN: tidak membuka seri baru, sedangkan posisi lamanya tetap memakai TP bersama, reduction dan kantong 8.7; layer marty sisi lawan tetap jalan, kecuali 3.19 = Ya (layer marty ikut berhenti). Di mode ini market liar (2.10–2.14, 6.6) dan mode berita 10.1 diabaikan: EA berdagang seperti GASPOL, sedangkan batas spread 9.2, pengaman equity 9.1 dan jam trading 9.3–9.4 tetap berlaku.
how.en: One EMA line (EMA 50 on timeframe 3.5, M15, by default) decides the trend. The trend only changes after 2 closed candles in a row are on the other side of the line, optionally also a safety distance and the fast EMA 3.6 on the same side; the trend state is saved, so a restart does not make it flip back and forth. New series only open on the side that follows the trend and (by default) also wait until EMAs 3.6–3.8 agree under rule 3.9. The opposite side is HELD: it opens no new series, while its old positions keep the shared TP, the reduction and pocket 8.7; its marty layers keep running unless 3.19 = Yes (marty layers stop too). In this mode the wild-market mode (2.10–2.14, 6.6) and the news modes 10.1 are ignored: the EA trades as in GASPOL, while the spread limit 9.2, the equity stop 9.1 and the trading hours 9.3–9.4 still apply.

use.id: Untuk yang ingin seri baru hanya searah satu garis tren yang jelas. Catatan uji: bila layer marty sisi lawan ikut ditahan (3.19 = Ya), basket yang melawan tren besar tidak bisa pulih dan rugi floating terus membesar, karena itu bawaannya Tidak.
use.en: For traders who want new series only in the direction of one clear trend line. Test note: when the opposite side's marty layers are held too (3.19 = Yes), a basket against a big trend cannot recover and its floating loss keeps growing, which is why the default is No.

title.id: EMA TREN vs TREN MURNI: bedanya
title.en: EMA TREN vs TREN MURNI: the difference

how.id: EMA TREN membaca 3 EMA (bawaan 20 / 50 / 200 di M15) pada candle tertutup: seri BUY baru hanya bila close > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200, seri SELL baru hanya bila kebalikannya. Selama EMA belum sejajar (sideways) tidak ada seri baru di kedua sisi. Basket yang sudah jalan tetap diurus penuh (marty, TP, reduction), sisi lawan boleh dibuka bila sisi yang jalan sudah mencapai 2.5 posisi, dan market liar serta mode berita tetap bekerja. TREN MURNI memakai satu garis EMA (bawaan EMA 50 M15) yang lengket: tren baru berganti sesudah 2 candle tertutup di seberang garis, jadi selalu ada satu sisi tren. Sisi tren membuka seri baru (menunggu RSI keluar dari jenuh dan 3 EMA searah); sisi lawan DITAHAN: tanpa seri baru, posisi lamanya tetap punya TP dan dibereskan kantong satu per satu. Market liar dan berita diabaikan supaya setelan tidak berubah.
how.en: EMA TREN reads 3 EMAs (default 20 / 50 / 200 on M15) on closed candles: a new BUY series only when close > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200, a new SELL series only for the reverse. While the EMAs are not lined up (sideways) neither side opens a new series. Running baskets are still fully managed (marty, TP, reduction), the opposite side may open once the running side reaches 2.5 positions, and wild-market and news modes keep working. TREN MURNI uses one sticky EMA line (default EMA 50 M15): the trend only flips after 2 closed candles on the other side of the line, so there is always one trend side. The trend side opens new series (waiting until RSI leaves overbought / oversold and the 3 EMAs agree); the opposite side is HELD: no new series, its old positions keep their TP and the pocket clears them one by one. Wild market and news are ignored so the settings never change.

use.id: EMA TREN lebih selektif: menunggu tren jelas dan diam saat pasar sideways. TREN MURNI lebih sering berganti arah (garis EMA 50 M15 bisa berbalik beberapa kali sehari), selalu punya satu sisi aktif, dan menahan sisi lawan sambil kantong membereskannya. Pilih sesuai gaya trading Anda dan coba dulu di akun kecil.
use.en: EMA TREN is more selective: it waits for a clear trend and stays quiet while the market moves sideways. TREN MURNI flips direction more often (the EMA 50 M15 line can turn several times a day), always has one active side, and holds the opposite side while the pocket clears it. Pick the one that fits your style and try it on a small account first.

how.id: Khusus TREN MURNI: seri BUY baru ditunda selama RSI (bawaan RSI 14 di M15, candle tertutup) jenuh beli, yaitu >= 70.0; seri SELL baru ditunda selama RSI jenuh jual, yaitu <= 30.0. Begitu RSI keluar dari zona jenuh dan tren masih searah, seri dibuka. Filter ini hanya mengatur seri baru, bukan layer marty.
how.en: PURE TREND only: a new BUY series waits while the RSI (RSI 14 on M15, closed candle, by default) is overbought, i.e. >= 70.0; a new SELL series waits while it is oversold, i.e. <= 30.0. As soon as the RSI leaves that zone and the trend still agrees, the series opens. The filter only controls new series, not marty layers.

use.id: Tidak membeli di pucuk atau menjual di dasar: harga dibiarkan bernapas dulu sebelum masuk searah tren.
use.en: It does not buy at the top or sell at the bottom: price gets room to breathe before the EA enters with the trend.

how.id: Seri BUY dan seri SELL bisa dinyalakan atau dimatikan sendiri-sendiri.
how.en: The BUY series and the SELL series can each be switched on or off.

use.id: Cocok saat Anda yakin satu arah saja, atau ingin satu chart khusus BUY dan chart lain khusus SELL.
use.en: Handy when you only trust one direction, or want one chart for BUY and another for SELL.

how.id: Bila dimatikan, EA tidak membuka seri baru tetapi tetap mengurus basket yang berjalan sampai TP.
how.en: When off, the EA opens no new series but keeps managing the running baskets until TP.

use.id: Berhenti dengan rapi, misalnya sebelum libur atau sebelum menarik dana, tanpa menutup posisi secara paksa.
use.en: Stop cleanly, for example before a holiday or a withdrawal, without force-closing positions.

how.id: Di mode EMA TREN / SMA KLASIK / KEDUANYA (bukan BARBAR dan bukan TREN MURNI), sisi lawan boleh dibuka bila sisi yang berjalan sudah mencapai sejumlah posisi (bawaan 4).
how.en: In the EMA TREND / CLASSIC SMA / BOTH modes (not BARBAR and not PURE TREND), the opposite side may open once the running side reaches a number of positions (4 by default).

use.id: Saat harga terus melawan, sisi lawan ikut mencari profit sehingga akun tidak hanya menunggu.
use.en: When price keeps going against a basket, the opposite side starts earning, so the account is not just waiting.

title.en: New series waits for a pullback

how.id: Sesudah TP, seri berikutnya menunggu harga mundur sejauh yang ditentukan (atau candle M1 baru / langsung).
how.en: After a TP the next series waits for price to pull back by a set distance (or a new M1 candle / at once).

use.id: Tidak langsung masuk di puncak gerakan, jadi harga awal seri baru lebih baik.
use.en: It does not jump in at the top of a move, so the new series starts at a better price.

how.id: PAUSE di panel menghentikan seri baru per sisi; opsional ikut menghentikan layer marty.
how.en: PAUSE on the panel stops new series per side; optionally it also stops new marty layers.

use.id: Kendali cepat dari chart tanpa membuka setting.
use.en: Quick control right from the chart without opening the settings.

intro.id: Mengatur besar lot supaya selalu sebanding dengan modal.
intro.en: Keeps the lot in proportion to the capital at all times.

how.id: Lot layer pertama bila lot ikut modal dimatikan (bawaan 0,01).
how.en: The first layer's lot when the lot does not follow the capital (0.01 by default).

use.id: Lot tetap yang mudah diatur untuk akun dengan modal pasti.
use.en: A fixed, easy lot for accounts with a set capital.

how.id: Lot dasar dihitung dari modal: 0,01 lot untuk setiap jumlah modal yang ditentukan.
how.en: The base lot comes from the capital: 0.01 lot for every set amount of capital.

use.id: Lot ikut membesar saat akun tumbuh dan mengecil setelah rugi, risiko tetap sebanding.
use.en: The lot grows with the account and shrinks after a loss, so the risk stays in proportion.

how.id: Setiap setup bisa diberi anggaran sendiri; opsional ikut bertambah / berkurang sesuai hasil setup itu.
how.en: Each setup can get its own budget; optionally it grows / shrinks with that setup's results.

use.id: Beberapa setup di satu akun tidak saling berebut modal, dan hasil tiap setup bisa dibandingkan dengan adil.
use.en: Several setups on one account do not fight over the capital, and each setup can be compared fairly.

how.id: Setiap layer baru memakai lot sedikit lebih besar (bawaan ×1,15).
how.en: Each new layer uses a slightly bigger lot (×1.15 by default).

use.id: Rata-rata harga cepat mendekat ke harga sekarang, sehingga TP basket lebih cepat tercapai.
use.en: The average price moves closer to the current price fast, so the basket TP is reached sooner.

how.id: Lot layer tidak pernah lebih kecil dari layer sebelumnya; lot yang sama paling banyak 2 kali, lalu dikalikan dari lot sebelumnya.
how.en: A layer never uses a smaller lot than the one before; the same lot at most twice, then it is multiplied from the previous lot.

use.id: Basket tetap efektif menarik rata-rata tanpa lot yang melonjak tiba-tiba.
use.en: The basket keeps pulling the average without sudden jumps in lot size.

how.id: Sesudah reduction / kantong, lot berikutnya dihitung dari urutan layer atau dari posisi terlama yang tersisa.
how.en: After a reduction / pocket cut, the next lot follows the layer order or the oldest position left.

use.id: Lot tetap konsisten walaupun posisi di tengah basket sudah ditutup.
use.en: Lots stay consistent even after positions in the middle of the basket are closed.

how.id: Batas atas lot per order.
how.en: An upper limit for the lot of any order.

use.id: Lot tidak pernah melewati batas yang Anda anggap aman.
use.en: The lot never goes past the limit you consider safe.

intro.id: Mengatur seberapa jauh layer berikutnya dibuka saat harga melawan.
intro.en: Sets how far away the next layer opens when price moves against the basket.

how.id: Layer baru dibuka setiap harga melawan sejauh jarak ini (dalam poin).
how.en: A new layer opens each time price moves this far against the basket (in points).

use.id: Jarak disesuaikan dengan volatilitas pair supaya basket tidak terlalu rapat.
use.en: The distance fits the pair's volatility so the basket is not too tight.

how.id: Sesudah layer tertentu (bawaan 4), jarak setiap layer dikali sedikit lebih jauh (bawaan ×1,1).
how.en: After a given layer (4 by default) each step is multiplied a little further (×1.1 by default).

use.id: Saat tren panjang, layer tidak menumpuk terlalu cepat sehingga modal lebih awet.
use.en: In a long trend the layers do not pile up too fast, so the capital lasts longer.

how.id: Sisi yang melawan tren EMA memakai jarak layer lebih lebar (bawaan ×2).
how.en: The side against the EMA trend uses a wider layer distance (×2 by default).

use.id: Basket yang melawan tren kuat bergerak lebih pelan, mengurangi floating saat tren berubah.
use.en: A basket against a strong trend moves more slowly, which limits the floating loss when the trend changes.

how.id: Batas jumlah layer per sisi (0 = tanpa batas).
how.en: Caps the number of layers per side (0 = no limit).

use.id: Pengaman tambahan untuk modal kecil.
use.en: Extra protection for small accounts.

how.id: Opsional: paling banyak satu layer baru per candle M1.
how.en: Optional: at most one new layer per M1 candle.

use.id: Saat harga melesat, layer tidak terbuka beruntun dalam hitungan detik.
use.en: When price spikes, layers do not open one after another within seconds.

intro.id: Satu target untuk seluruh basket, dihitung dari harga rata-rata.
intro.en: One target for the whole basket, measured from the average price.

how.id: Semua posisi satu sisi ditutup bersamaan saat harga mencapai rata-rata ditambah target.
how.en: Every position of a side closes together when price reaches the average plus the target.

use.id: Basket panjang pun cukup menunggu pantulan kecil untuk selesai profit.
use.en: Even a long basket only needs a small bounce to close in profit.

how.id: Mode RIIL memasang TP di server broker dan dijaga EA; mode VIRTUAL hanya ditutup EA.
how.en: REAL mode places the TP on the broker server and the EA guards it; VIRTUAL mode is closed by the EA only.

use.id: Dengan TP riil, profit tetap terkunci walaupun PC / VPS mati.
use.en: With a real TP the profit is still taken even if the PC / VPS is off.

how.id: Setiap 5 detik EA memeriksa TP tiap posisi; TP yang dihapus broker dipasang ulang.
how.en: Every 5 seconds the EA checks each position's TP; a TP removed by the broker is put back.

use.id: Tidak ada posisi yang tertinggal tanpa target.
use.en: No position is ever left without a target.

how.id: Target ikut menutup biaya swap yang sudah berjalan.
how.en: The target also covers the swap that has built up.

use.id: Profit yang tercatat benar-benar bersih.
use.en: The profit you see is truly net.

how.id: Basket yang lebih tua dari sekian jam memakai target lebih kecil.
how.en: A basket older than a set number of hours uses a smaller target.

use.id: Basket lama cepat selesai sehingga modal kembali bebas.
use.en: Old baskets finish sooner and free the capital again.

intro.id: Mengunci profit basket lalu membiarkannya terus berjalan selama tren masih searah.
intro.en: Locks the basket profit, then lets it run while the trend keeps going.

how.id: Saat harga (bid untuk BUY, ask untuk SELL) sudah maju sejauh trailing start dari harga rata-rata basket, trailing aktif: SL pertama dipasang di belakang harga, minimal sedikit di atas titik impas basket (swap ikut dihitung). Selama trailing aktif EA tidak menambah layer marty di sisi itu.
how.en: Once price (bid for BUY, ask for SELL) has moved the trailing start distance beyond the basket average, trailing switches on: the first SL is placed behind price, at least slightly beyond the basket break-even (swap included). While trailing is on, the EA adds no new marty layers on that side.

use.id: Profit basket langsung terkunci dan tidak bisa berbalik menjadi rugi.
use.en: The basket profit is locked at once and cannot turn back into a loss.

how.id: SL selalu berjarak sekian poin di belakang harga terbaik yang sudah dicapai, hanya bergerak searah profit, dan tidak pernah di bawah titik impas.
how.en: The SL always stays a set number of points behind the best price reached, only moves in the profit direction and never goes below break-even.

use.id: Memberi ruang napas supaya basket tidak tertutup oleh goyangan kecil.
use.en: Gives the basket room to breathe, so small wiggles do not close it.

how.id: SL baru digeser setiap harga maju minimal sejauh step.
how.en: The SL only moves when price has advanced by at least the step.

use.id: SL naik bertahap mengikuti tren tanpa modifikasi order yang berlebihan.
use.en: The SL climbs step by step with the trend without excessive order changes.

how.id: RIIL memasang SL di server broker pada setiap posisi basket (EA tetap menutup basket bila harga menyentuh level itu, sebagai cadangan). VIRTUAL menyimpan SL di EA (tetap tersimpan saat restart) dan EA yang menutup seluruh basket saat harga menyentuhnya.
how.en: REAL puts the SL on the broker server for every position of the basket (the EA still closes the basket if price touches that level, as a backup). VIRTUAL keeps the SL inside the EA (kept across restarts) and the EA closes the whole basket when price touches it.

use.id: RIIL tetap melindungi walaupun PC / VPS mati; VIRTUAL tidak memperlihatkan level SL ke broker.
use.en: REAL still protects you if the PC / VPS goes down; VIRTUAL does not show the SL level to the broker.

how.id: Bila Ya, begitu trailing aktif TP bersama dilepas (TP di broker dihapus) sehingga basket tidak berhenti di target biasa. Bila Tidak, TP bersama tetap berlaku dan basket ditutup oleh TP atau SL, mana yang lebih dulu tersentuh.
how.en: If Yes, as soon as trailing is on the shared TP is released (the broker TP is removed), so the basket does not stop at the normal target. If No, the shared TP stays and the basket closes at the TP or the SL, whichever is hit first.

use.id: Saat tren kuat, profit bisa jauh melebihi TP biasa; trailing yang menutupnya ketika harga berbalik.
use.en: In a strong trend the profit can go far beyond the normal TP; trailing closes it when price turns.

sub.id: basket ditutup di SL, profit maksimal
sub.en: basket closes at the SL, profit maximised

intro.id: Memangkas basket panjang memakai profit, bukan dengan cut loss.
intro.en: Trims long baskets with profit instead of a cut loss.

how.id: Mulai jumlah posisi tertentu (bawaan 6), posisi terbaru yang untung menutup posisi terlama yang rugi bila untungnya cukup (rugi + 25%).
how.en: From a set number of positions (6 by default) the newest winning position closes the oldest losing one when its profit is enough (loss + 25%).

use.id: Basket menyusut dari posisi terburuknya tanpa menambah rugi.
use.en: The basket shrinks from its worst position without adding a loss.

how.id: Posisi rugi baru ditutup sesudah profit posisi terbaru benar-benar masuk ke balance.
how.en: The losing position is closed only after the newest position's profit has really reached the balance.

use.id: Tidak ada pemangkasan yang setengah jalan saat harga bergerak cepat.
use.en: No half-done trims when price moves fast.

title.en: Only while the basket is in loss

how.id: Reduction tidak berjalan bila basket sedang profit; garis reduction juga disembunyikan.
how.en: Reduction does not run while the basket is in profit; its line is hidden as well.

use.id: Basket yang sudah untung dibiarkan menuju TP penuh.
use.en: A basket already in profit is left to reach its full TP.

intro.id: Fitur khas GOLD HUNTER GARUDA yang jarang ditemukan di EA marty lain.
intro.en: A GOLD HUNTER GARUDA signature, rarely found in other marty EAs.

how.id: Sebagian dari setiap profit tertutup (bawaan 50%) disisihkan ke kantong.
how.en: Part of every closed profit (50% by default) is set aside in the pocket.

use.id: EA punya cadangan khusus untuk membebaskan posisi yang tersangkut.
use.en: The EA keeps a reserve just for freeing stuck positions.

how.id: Saat basket melewati sekian layer (bawaan 10) dan floating mencapai batas, kantong menutup posisi terlama yang macet.
how.en: When a basket passes a number of layers (10 by default) and the floating loss reaches the limit, the pocket closes the oldest stuck position.

use.id: Saat tren berubah dan basket tertahan jauh, beban terberatnya dilunasi sehingga rata-rata mendekat dan TP kembali dekat.
use.en: When the trend turns and a basket is stuck far away, its heaviest load is paid off, the average moves closer and the TP is near again.

how.id: Pemotongan berikutnya menunggu tambahan layer atau jeda waktu (bawaan 30 menit); kantong bisa direset berkala.
how.en: The next cut waits for another layer or a pause (30 minutes by default); the pocket can be reset regularly.

use.id: Kantong dipakai hemat dan tidak habis dalam sekali gerak.
use.en: The pocket is spent carefully and never emptied in one move.

how.id: Di TREN MURNI, kantong membayar posisi sisi yang DITAHAN satu per satu (posisi rugi terlama dulu) tanpa syarat jumlah layer 8.3 dan floating 8.4. Jeda 8.6 tetap berlaku dan sebuah posisi hanya ditutup bila saldo kantong cukup menutup seluruh ruginya.
how.en: In PURE TREND the pocket pays off the positions of the HELD side one at a time (the oldest losing position first), without the layer rule 8.3 and the floating rule 8.4. The 8.6 pause still applies, and a position is only closed when the pocket balance covers its whole loss.

use.id: Beban lama yang melawan tren dikurangi sedikit demi sedikit memakai profit dari sisi yang searah tren.
use.en: Old positions against the trend are cleared bit by bit with the profit of the side that follows the trend.

note.id: Dibuat khusus untuk trading marty: saat tren berubah dan basket tertinggal jauh, kantong melunasi posisi terberatnya dari profit yang sudah ditabung, sehingga trading tidak tersangkut.
note.en: Built for marty trading: when the trend changes and a basket is left far behind, the pocket pays off its heaviest position from profit that was saved earlier, so trades do not stay stuck.

intro.id: Mode cepat saat pasar bergerak liar.
intro.en: A fast mode for wild markets.

how.id: Pasar dianggap liar bila 2 candle M1 bergerak minimal sekian kali jarak layer (bawaan 3×).
how.en: The market counts as wild when 2 M1 candles move at least a number of layer distances (3× by default).

use.id: EA mengenali momen volatil secara otomatis.
use.en: The EA spots volatile moments on its own.

how.id: Saat liar, seri baru dibuka tanpa menunggu pullback dan layer tanpa jeda.
how.en: While wild, new series open without waiting for a pullback and layers without pauses.

use.id: Peluang di pasar cepat tidak terlewat.
use.en: Chances in a fast market are not missed.

how.id: Target saat liar = persentase dari TP biasa (bawaan 70%).
how.en: The target while wild = a percentage of the normal TP (70% by default).

use.id: Profit diamankan lebih cepat sebelum pasar berbalik.
use.en: Profit is banked sooner, before the market turns.

intro.id: EA membaca kalender ekonomi MT5 sendiri, 7 hari ke depan.
intro.en: The EA reads the MT5 economic calendar itself, 7 days ahead.

how.id: GASPOL tetap trading, TAHAN tidak buka seri / layer baru, COPET BUY & SELL cepat dengan TP kecil, IKUT TREN searah hasil berita, AUTO memilih sendiri.
how.en: GASPOL keeps trading, HOLD opens no new series / layers, SCALP quick BUY & SELL with a small TP, FOLLOW TREND goes with the news result, AUTO decides itself.

use.id: Satu EA bisa dipakai dengan gaya aman maupun agresif saat berita.
use.en: One EA for a careful or an aggressive style around news.

how.id: Menit sebelum dan sesudah rilis berita dampak tinggi yang dianggap jendela berita.
how.en: The minutes before and after a high-impact release that count as the news window.

use.id: Waktu rawan dikenali tepat, di luar itu EA trading normal.
use.en: The risky time is pinned down; outside it the EA trades normally.

how.id: Hasil berita (aktual vs perkiraan) menentukan arah; baru dipakai bila harga sudah bergerak searah, lalu berlaku sekian jam.
how.en: The news result (actual vs forecast) sets the direction; it is used only once price has moved that way, then it holds for some hours.

use.id: Tidak ikut tertipu reaksi palsu sesaat setelah rilis.
use.en: Not fooled by a fake reaction right after the release.

intro.id: Batas keselamatan akun yang bekerja otomatis.
intro.en: Account safety limits that work on their own.

how.id: Semua posisi ditutup bila floating mencapai batas % yang Anda pilih.
how.en: Every position is closed when the floating loss reaches the % limit you choose.

use.id: Kerugian terburuk akun sudah Anda tentukan sejak awal.
use.en: You decide the account's worst loss up front.

how.id: Order baru ditahan saat spread melebar di atas batas.
how.en: New orders wait while the spread is wider than the limit.

use.id: Tidak masuk di harga buruk saat rollover atau berita.
use.en: No entries at bad prices during rollover or news.

how.id: Seri baru hanya dibuka di jam yang Anda pilih (bawaan 24 jam).
how.en: New series only open in the hours you choose (24 hours by default).

use.id: Hindari sesi yang tidak cocok dengan pair Anda.
use.en: Avoid sessions that do not suit your pair.

how.id: EA hanya jalan di pair yang ditulis.
how.en: The EA only runs on the pair you enter.

use.id: Preset tidak salah terpasang di chart pair lain.
use.en: A preset is never run on the wrong pair by mistake.

how.id: EA memastikan akun HEDGING; saat Algo Trading dimatikan, hanya order baru yang ditahan sementara basket tetap diurus.
how.en: The EA checks for a HEDGING account; when Algo Trading is off, only new orders wait while the baskets are still managed.

use.id: Basket tidak pernah ditinggalkan tanpa pengurus.
use.en: A basket is never left unattended.

how.id: Batas selisih harga yang masih diterima saat order dieksekusi.
how.en: The price difference still accepted when an order is filled.

use.id: Order tidak terisi di harga yang terlalu jauh saat pasar cepat.
use.en: Orders are not filled too far away in a fast market.

intro.id: Semua informasi penting terlihat langsung di chart.
intro.en: Everything important is visible right on the chart.

how.id: Status, pil keadaan EA (AKTIF / SIAGA / TUTUP / OFF ...), basket BUY / SELL, kantong, berita, profit hari / minggu / bulan, lisensi, spread, margin dan DD maksimal. Bingkai HUD bernyala: cyan normal, kuning peringatan, merah bahaya. Tombol − menciutkan panel (tersimpan), chart sempit otomatis memakai panel ringkas, dan SETELAN + menampilkan setelan seri.
how.en: Status, an EA state pill (ACTIVE / STANDBY / CLOSED / OFF ...), BUY / SELL baskets, pocket, news, profit per day / week / month, licence, spread, margin and maximum DD. A glowing HUD frame: cyan when normal, amber for a warning, red for danger. The − button collapses the panel (remembered), narrow charts switch to a compact panel automatically, and SETELAN + shows the series settings.

use.id: Kondisi akun terbaca dalam sekali lihat, rapi juga untuk live streaming.
use.en: The account state at a glance, tidy enough for live streaming.

how.id: PAUSE BUY / SELL langsung di panel. CLOSE BUY / SELL perlu klik kedua dalam 4 detik (tombol menjadi merah "YAKIN?"); selama menunggu, +PAUSE menutup semua sekaligus mem-pause sisi itu. Tanpa jendela pop-up, jadi EA tetap mengurus TP dan pengaman selama menunggu.
how.en: PAUSE BUY / SELL straight from the panel. CLOSE BUY / SELL needs a second click within 4 seconds (the button turns red, "YAKIN?"); while it waits, +PAUSE closes everything and pauses that side. No pop-up window, so the EA keeps managing TP and protection while it waits.

use.id: Ambil alih kapan saja tanpa salah klik.
use.en: Take over at any time without misclicks.

how.id: Garis EMA, rata-rata, TP basket, layer marty berikutnya, reduction dan trailing, semuanya di belakang candle. Setiap garis punya chip harga di kanan candle terakhir: urut sesuai garisnya, tidak pernah saling menimpa, diringkas otomatis bila ruang sempit, dan garis satu sisi yang berdempetan digabung. Garis EMA mengikuti timeframe chart dengan halus di M1 sampai D1.
how.en: Lines for the EMAs, the average price, the basket TP, the next marty layer, the reduction and the trailing stop, all behind the candles. Every line gets a price chip right of the last candle: in line order, never overlapping, shortened automatically when space is tight, and lines of one side that sit close together are merged. The EMA lines follow the chart timeframe smoothly from M1 to D1.

use.id: Cara kerja EA terlihat jelas, bukan kotak hitam.
use.en: You can see how the EA works; it is not a black box.

how.id: Garis pembatas tren digambar tebal (TREN MURNI dan BARBAR: EMA 3.10; EMA TREN dan KEDUANYA: EMA sedang 3.7; SMA KLASIK: SMA 3.3). Sejak tren terakhir berganti, zona hijau di atas garis (BUY) dan merah di bawahnya (SELL) mengikuti garis itu. Panah dan jam WIB menandai pergantian tren yang terlihat, tulisannya tidak saling menimpa dan berada di luar candle. Kartu kanan atas menulis tren dan kekuatannya (NAIK / TURUN · KUAT / LEMAH, SIDEWAYS), sejak jam berapa (WIB), jarak harga ke garis, lalu sisi BUY dan SELL: jalan, ditahan, menunggu atau pause. Di BARBAR kartu menulis "info saja": BUY dan SELL tetap jalan. Hanya tampilan, tidak mengubah cara EA trading.
how.en: The trend dividing line is drawn thick (PURE TREND and BARBAR: EMA 3.10; EMA TREND and BOTH: middle EMA 3.7; CLASSIC SMA: SMA 3.3). Since the last trend change, a green zone above the line (BUY) and a red one below it (SELL) follow that line. Arrows with the WIB time mark the visible trend changes; their texts never overlap and sit outside the candles. The top-right card shows the trend and its strength (UP / DOWN · STRONG / WEAK, SIDEWAYS), since when (WIB), the distance from price to the line, then the BUY and SELL sides: running, held, waiting or paused. In BARBAR the card says "info only": BUY and SELL keep running. Display only; it does not change how the EA trades.

use.id: Arah tren, kapan berganti dan alasan sebuah sisi ditahan bisa dipantau langsung dengan mata.
use.en: The trend direction, when it changed and why a side is held can be followed by eye.

how.id: Nyala bingkai panel, kartu tren dan keterangan berdenyut pelan (bawaan mati). Tidak berjalan di mode ringan 11.15 dan di tester; bingkainya disimpan dua tingkat sehingga denyut tidak membebani MT5.
how.en: The glow of the panel, trend card and legend frames pulses slowly (off by default). It does not run in light mode 11.15 or in the tester; the frame is stored at two levels, so the pulse puts no load on MT5.

use.id: Tampilan chart terasa hidup saat live streaming.
use.en: The chart feels alive on a live stream.

how.id: Garis titik vertikal di awal hari ini (emas) dan hari trading sebelumnya H-1 (abu-abu), dengan label hari dan tanggal di bawah judul chart. Mengikuti hari server, sama dengan "profit hari ini" di panel; Senin langsung menunjuk Jumat. Tidak tampil di D1 ke atas.
how.en: Dotted vertical lines at the start of today (gold) and of the previous trading day H-1 (grey), labelled with the day and date below the chart title. They follow the server day, the same as the panel's "profit today"; on Monday H-1 points to Friday. Hidden on D1 and above.

use.id: Langsung terlihat gerakan dan posisi mana yang terjadi hari ini dan mana yang kemarin.
use.en: You see at once which moves and positions happened today and which yesterday.

how.id: Angka profit / rugi muncul di chart saat posisi tutup. Angka yang berdempetan di layar digabung jadi satu jumlah (misalnya +120.50 ·3×), jadi chart tetap rapi di semua zoom dan timeframe; zoom dekat menampilkan angka satu per satu. Emas = dibayar kantong, biru muda = hasil reduction.
how.en: Profit / loss figures appear on the chart when positions close. Figures that crowd together on screen are merged into one sum (for example +120.50 ·3×), so the chart stays tidy at every zoom and timeframe; zooming in shows them one by one. Gold = paid by the pocket, light blue = reduction result.

use.id: Riwayat terlihat langsung tanpa membuka history.
use.en: The history is visible without opening the history tab.

how.id: Gambar panel lebih hemat saat banyak EA di satu MetaTrader.
how.en: Lighter drawing when many EAs share one MetaTrader.

use.id: VPS kecil tetap lancar.
use.en: Small VPSs stay smooth.

how.id: Jarak panel dari kiri dan atas chart dalam piksel.
how.en: The panel distance from the left and the top of the chart in pixels.

use.id: Panel bisa digeser supaya tidak menutupi candle yang ingin Anda lihat.
use.en: Move the panel so it never hides the candles you want to see.

how.id: Tema gelap GOLD HUNTER dan ruang kosong otomatis sehingga candle tidak tertutup keterangan.
how.en: The dark GOLD HUNTER theme and automatic spacing so the candles are never covered by labels.

use.id: Chart rapi dan nyaman dibaca berjam-jam.
use.en: A tidy chart that is easy on the eyes for hours.

how.id: Profit hari / minggu / bulan dihitung dari EA ini saja atau seluruh akun, plus pilihan menampilkan bulan-bulan sebelumnya.
how.en: Profit per day / week / month counted for this EA only or the whole account, with an option to show previous months.

use.id: Hasil setup terlihat jelas, terpisah dari trading manual.
use.en: The setup's results stay clear, apart from manual trading.

intro.id: Satu EA, banyak setup, hasilnya dibandingkan.
intro.en: One EA, many setups, results compared.

how.id: Setiap chart dengan nomor EA dan nama sendiri menjadi setup terpisah dengan basket, kantong dan hasil sendiri.
how.en: Every chart with its own EA number and name is a separate setup with its own baskets, pocket and results.

use.id: Uji beberapa gaya sekaligus di satu akun dan pilih yang terbaik.
use.en: Test several styles on one account at once and keep the best.

how.id: Teks komentar yang menempel di setiap order EA (terlihat di tab Trade).
how.en: The comment text attached to every EA order (visible in the Trade tab).

use.id: Order EA mudah dikenali dan dibedakan dari order manual.
use.en: EA orders are easy to tell apart from manual ones.

how.id: Preset tiap pair disalin installer ke MetaTrader dan ikut update otomatis.
how.en: The installer copies the preset of every pair into MetaTrader and keeps it updated.

use.id: Mulai dari setelan yang sudah disiapkan, tidak perlu meracik dari nol.
use.en: Start from prepared settings instead of building from scratch.

intro.id: Transparan, terkunci di akun Anda, selalu versi terbaru.
intro.en: Transparent, locked to your account, always up to date.

how.id: EA mengirim profit, drawdown dan basket yang berjalan ke member area.
how.en: The EA sends profit, drawdown and running baskets to the member area.

use.id: Pantau dari HP kapan saja, angka langsung dari EA.
use.en: Follow it from your phone at any time, numbers straight from the EA.

how.id: Peringatan bila floating melewati batas % atau satu basket mencapai sekian layer.
how.en: A warning when the floating loss passes a % limit or a basket reaches a number of layers.

use.id: Anda tahu lebih awal sebelum situasi memburuk.
use.en: You know early, before things get worse.

how.id: Setup bisa diberi label Low / Medium / High yang tampil di laporan web.
how.en: A setup can carry a Low / Medium / High label shown in the web report.

use.id: Pengunjung langsung tahu gaya risiko setiap setup.
use.en: Visitors see the risk style of each setup at once.

title.id: Preset & riwayat trading otomatis di web
title.en: Preset & trading history sent to the web

how.id: Bersama laporan rutin, EA mengirim semua inputnya (kunci web selalu dikosongkan) dan setiap deal yang tertutup: tiket, waktu, arah, lot, harga, profit, swap dan komisi. Preset setup di halaman live selalu sama dengan chart saat itu, dan web mencocokkan total profit dengan jumlah semua deal.
how.en: With its regular report the EA sends every input (the web key is always blank) and every closed deal: ticket, time, side, lot, price, profit, swap and commission. The live setup's preset always matches the chart, and the web checks the total profit against the sum of all deals.

use.id: Ubah setelan di EA, preset di web ikut berubah sendiri; angka laporan bisa dibuktikan sampai ke riwayat trading.
use.en: Change a setting in the EA and the web preset follows by itself; the report figures can be proven down to the trading history.

how.id: Panel menampilkan jenis lisensi dan sisa masa aktif; 24 jam terakhir ada pengingat tiap jam.
how.en: The panel shows the licence type and the time left; in the last 24 hours it reminds you every hour.

use.id: Tidak ada lisensi yang habis tanpa disadari.
use.en: No licence runs out unnoticed.

how.id: Versi EA dan preset baru terpasang sendiri; setup yang sedang jalan di chart tidak diubah.
how.en: New EA versions and presets install themselves; the setup running on a chart is never changed.

use.id: Selalu memakai versi terbaru tanpa repot.
use.en: Always on the latest version without effort.
